title: Keep Windows installs, background updates, and agent startups free of extra console windows.
changes: Hide the Windows console for detached update handoff, pinned npm execution, Task Scheduler checks, and agent diagnostics; preserve non-Windows subprocess behavior.
Launch staged Windows Node/npm directly with CreateNoWindow rather than a visible npm.cmd shell, including paths with spaces and Unicode characters.
Keep runtime search, archive operations, and screenshot command probes from flashing additional CMD windows.

On startup, repair only verified npm-generated PowerShell launchers that shadow the existing trusted remcp.cmd, without changing ExecutionPolicy, custom scripts, pairing credentials, or active services.
Add native Windows x64/ARM64 regression coverage for hidden console windows, installer exit codes, malicious package specs, and safe launcher ownership; retain versioned public-first release gates.
